subject.title: Consolidate duplicate TypeScript gateway WebSocket clients

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the internal gateway-client consolidation now, while explicitly deferring any public npm support contract to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49178?
rationale: The code duplication is concrete, but selecting the permanent package and adapter boundary affects a security-sensitive protocol client and future SDK direction; the protected maintainer label confirms that this architectural choice should not be automated.

options.title: Sponsor bounded consolidation
options.body: Approve one internal lifecycle engine with explicit Node and browser adapters, parity tests, and no new public API commitment.

options.title: Sequence after SDK decision
options.body: Keep both implementations temporarily and defer consolidation until maintainers decide the public package and compatibility contract in the broader issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded consolidation
recommendation.body: Approve one internal lifecycle engine with explicit Node and browser adapters, parity tests, and no new public API commitment.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored, assigned, and precisely scoped the internal-versus-public boundary presented by this issue.
